operations.summary: Send search terms to receive the most relevant articles and companies.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] contentpro search [PARAMS] terms [SCHEMA] article company content pro snippets

operations.summary: Send search terms to receive the most relevant companies along with text snippets.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] search [PARAMS] page terms [SCHEMA] company search similar snippet

operations.summary: Send a company website to receive a list of companies related to them.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] similar [PARAMS] link page [SCHEMA] company input similar

operations.summary: The /contentpro-similar-text endpoint accepts and arbitrary piece of text and returns similar articles and blogs written by companies.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] contentpro similar text [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] article company content pro snippets
